'''The Vile Reef''' is a colorful reef portion of the [[Great Sea]] near the southwestern tip of the [[Eastern Kingdoms]], mostly noted by travelers on the west coast of [[Stranglethorn Vale]] near [[Grom'gol Base Camp]]. It is populated by [[murloc]]s who inhabit sunken [[troll]] ruins among the reef. The [[Altar of the Tides]] can be found here.

[[Giant Clam]]s can be found scattered among the corals. These clams have been rumored to hold [[Blue Pearl]]s. Also, many floating wreckages can be found along its coasts.

==Speculation==
It is possible that the Vile Reef holds the ruins of the ancient city of [[I'lalai]]. It could be possible that the ruins were sunken during the [[Great Sundering]].
